## Terraform Provider for SAP Integration Suite v0.3.2

### Overview

0.3.2 is a patch release of 0.3.1. 0.3.1 rejects access policy descriptions
that SAP cannot keep while Terraform plans. 0.3.2 adds the same check for the
four other access policy strings that SAP shortens without an error. Nothing
else changes.

### Fixed behavior

#### Access policy strings SAP would shorten

A tenant probe wrote values of 200 to 5000 characters to every string of an
access policy and of its references. SAP accepted every request and stored
only the first characters:

| Attribute | SAP keeps |
|---|---|
| `sapintegrationsuite_access_policy.role_name` | 200 characters |
| `sapintegrationsuite_access_policy_reference.name` | 50 characters |
| `sapintegrationsuite_access_policy_reference.description` | 200 characters |
| `sapintegrationsuite_access_policy_reference.value` | 150 characters |

With 0.3.1, a longer value passed the plan. SAP created the object with the
shortened value, the provider read back something different from the plan,
and the apply failed after the object already existed in SAP, or later plans
kept showing a change.

0.3.2 checks these lengths when Terraform validates the configuration, before
SAP is called. The error names the limit and the length found. The provider
does not shorten values itself, because a silently cut role name or condition
would protect different artifacts than the configuration says.

```terraform
resource "sapintegrationsuite_access_policy_reference" "flows" {
  access_policy_id = sapintegrationsuite_access_policy.core.id
  name             = "Sales integration flows" # at most 50 characters
  artifact_type    = "INTEGRATION_FLOW"
  attribute        = "Name"
  operator         = "regularExpression"
  value            = "^SALES_ORDERS_.*$" # at most 150 characters
}
```

SAP counts characters, not bytes: 200 umlauts were kept. No SAP source states
these limits; they were observed on a tenant, and an acceptance test creates
every string at its limit and reads it back unchanged.

#### Release description

The GitHub releases of 0.2.0, 0.3.0 and 0.3.1 first showed only the tag
message, because GoReleaser's `changelog.disable` setting also skipped the
hand-written release notes. 0.3.2 carries the fix that the 0.4.0 line already
has, so this description appears without manual editing.

### Affected resources

- `sapintegrationsuite_access_policy`, attribute `role_name`.
- `sapintegrationsuite_access_policy_reference`, attributes `name`,
  `description` and `value`.

The data sources are unchanged. Read and import keep whatever SAP returns.

### Upgrade guidance

- No resource is renamed and no state is migrated. Configurations within the
  limits need no change.
- A longer value now fails `terraform plan`. Shorten it. A reference whose
  value lists many exact names is better written as one `regularExpression`,
  or split into several references.
- A policy or reference that an earlier apply left in SAP with a shortened
  value is replaced by the next apply if it is in the state. If it is not,
  delete it in SAP, or import it and set the value to the text SAP kept.

The Provider Upgrades guide on the Terraform Registry describes these cases.

### Known impact

- Configurations with longer values must be shortened. SAP never kept more
  than the limits, so no information that was stored in SAP is lost.
- Characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane, such as emoji, count as
  two characters, because how SAP counts them was not tested.
